status: Sri Lankan records refer to G. dreyfussi turkestanica (Gajapathy & Surendran 2012)

author: (Theodor)

diagnostic_note: ♀ convex cibarial tooth row and round, finely spiculate spermatheca; ♂ genital filaments with dilated tips (Lewis 1978). Dark part of pigment belt straight anteriorly (Lewis 1987).

author: (Wang, Ku & Yuan, 1974)

focus_record: Pha Tong cave, Chiang Rai (Renaux Torres et al. 2023)

author: Mitra & Roy, 1953
status: Treated as a species within P. argentipes s.l. (Wijerathna & Gunathilaka 2020)

author: Lewis

author: Mesghali
medical_note: Known secondary vector of Leishmania major in India and Iran (cited in Wijerathna & Gunathilaka 2020).

author: Depaquit, Pellot & Siriyasatien, 2023

diagnostic_note: Close to P. stantoni. ♂ aedeagal ducts very long (640-671 µm), gonocoxite with median tuft of about 56 setae, accessory spine between paramere and parameral sheath. ♀ spermathecal common duct about 508 µm, individual ducts about 69 µm. Not in any printed key in this collection.

author: Newstead
focus_record: Pha Tong cave, Chiang Rai (Renaux Torres et al. 2023)

medical_note: Suspected vector of Leishmania martiniquensis in Thailand (cited in Wijerathna & Gunathilaka 2020).

author: Lewis & Jeffery
focus_record: Rare: 1/261 females in Thai samples (Depaquit et al. 2019)
medical_note: Repeatedly suspected as a vector of L. martiniquensis in Thailand; role 'very questionable' (Depaquit et al. 2019).

author: Depaquit et al., 2025
diagnostic_note: Many comb-like cibarial teeth; separated from S. rudnicki and S. brevicaulis by length of f1 and number of cibarial teeth. Male unknown.
